criteria.assessment: Constructive statements have explicit inventory, branch, regularity and boundary conditions. Negative scope statements address only the specified data/model; no global exclusion quantifier is promoted.
Completed direct arguments checked for convex moments, positive capacity, implicit root, finite atomic scan, covariant boundary and coupled error bounds. Numerical samples do not replace the proofs.
Nonempty positive source-bound and independent exact-box/atomic cases are constructed. Definitions or deliberately contradictory assumptions are not counted as exclusion achievements.
Atomic jumps arise from finite packet energy/count in the EOS; missing lower trace arises from information loss in two moments. Tool errors are not physical obstruction mechanisms.
The distinctions select continuous bisection, retained atomic prefixes, fixed-branch coupled domains and explicit later crossing policies.
Four close primary sources were read in declared sections. Literature comparison is contextual; no global novelty/absence claim or imported sharp-cutoff uniqueness theorem.
Candidate-nonauthor independent review directly checked proofs, source and actual outputs. General sharpness or necessity is not claimed beyond demonstrated scope.
